title: Alibaba Qwen Image Generation Model Qwen-Image-3.0 Launches with Open API and Starts at 0.18 Yuan per Image
excerpt: On August 5, the Alibaba Qwen image generation model Qwen-Image-3.0 was officially launched on the Qwen AI platform and fully opened to users. The flagship Pro
content_html:
On August 5, the Alibaba Qwen image generation model Qwen-Image-3.0 was officially launched on the Qwen AI platform and fully opened to users. The flagship Pro version and standard Standard version simultaneously opened their APIs, with the starting price for text-to-image generation at 0.18 yuan per image. Overseas users can access it through Qwen Cloud. In the latest text-to-image ranking on the international evaluation platform Arena.ai, this model ranked first domestically.

The Qwen-Image-3.0 focuses on ultra-long text understanding and detailed rendering. The model supports up to 4.5k token instructions, enabling the generation of complex layouts such as storyboards, exams, and nine-grid knowledge maps in one go. In terms of detail expression, it can precisely restore small text of 10px and entire pages of LaTeX academic formulas, with realistic skin and hair on human figures, and supports seamless restoration of ancient paintings. Meanwhile, the model covers over 100 art styles, native rendering in 12 languages, and includes world knowledge and online search capabilities.

Currently, the model has been integrated into commercial workflows such as e-commerce visual effects, film storyboards, advertising posters, and architectural rendering. In terms of pricing, the Standard version is 0.18 yuan per image for 1K/2K; the Pro version is 0.25 yuan and 0.5 yuan per image for 1K and 2K respectively, with image editing input as low as 0.02 yuan per image, further enhancing the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of commercial-grade AI image generation.

Qwen AI Platform:

https://platform.qianwenai.com/try-ai?scene=image&models=qwen-image-3.0-pro

content_html_zh:
8月5日，阿里巴巴Qwen图像生成模型Qwen-Image-3.0在Qwen AI平台正式上线，并向用户全面开放。 旗舰Pro版和标准版同时开放API，文字转图片起价为0.18元/张。 海外用户可以通过Qwen Cloud访问。 在国际评测平台Arena.ai最新的文本转图像排名中，该模型排名国内第一。

Qwen-Image-3.0专注于超长文本理解和细节渲染。 该模型最多支持4.5k条token指令，可一次性生成故事板、考试、九格知识图谱等复杂布局。 细节表达方面，可以精准还原10px的小文字和整页LaTeX学术公式，人物皮肤、头发逼真，支持古画无缝还原。 同时，该模型涵盖了100多种艺术风格，12种语言的原生渲染，并包含世界知识和在线搜索功能。

目前，该模型已融入电商视觉特效、电影分镜、广告海报、建筑渲染等商业工作流程中。 定价方面，标准版1K/2K每张0.18元； Pro版本1K、2K每幅图像分别为0.25元和0.5元，图像编辑投入低至每幅图像0.02元，进一步提升商业级AI图像生成的效率和成本效益。
